reason: Notion and Figma say so of their own systems, and Sentry reports an outage on a write-heavy one. Three self-selected accounts cannot show how common this is or at what size it happens; Figma also names processor and input and output limits.
text: On large or heavily written databases, vacuum upkeep was reported to give trouble before a single server’s size limit was reached, and was among the reasons for sharding.
